metrics.name: Logic
metrics.detail: Activities lacking a predecessor and/or successor link.

metrics.name: Leads
metrics.detail: Leads (negative lag) distort the critical path.

metrics.name: Lags
metrics.detail: Relationships that use a positive lag.

metrics.name: Hard Constraints
metrics.detail: No hard date constraints are used in this model.

metrics.name: High Float
metrics.detail: High float often signals missing successor logic.

metrics.name: Negative Float
metrics.detail: Negative float means the plan is behind its logic-driven need dates.

metrics.name: High Duration
metrics.detail: Long activities should be broken into shorter tasks.

metrics.name: Resources
metrics.detail: Cost-loaded activities are required for EVM.

metrics.name: Missed Tasks
metrics.detail: Requires actual progress vs baseline (execution data).

metrics.name: Critical Path Test
metrics.detail: The finish-driving activity lies on a zero-float logic chain.

metrics.name: Critical Path Length Index (CPLI)
metrics.detail: CPLI = (CP length + total float) ÷ CP length.
